solverBot(js-runtime-L22-exit) reach-exit (192,64)->L29: the combat ladder is EXHAUSTED. The corridor passes through danger at (136.3,96.9) — enemy:wallflyer@128,80 (a static "Enemy" body at its placement (this room is stepped, so this class is unbridged and does not move), priced "stepped" by `contactPricing`) — and every rung of ⚖ §11.8a's order refused:
  avoid: the danger-forbidden corridor STILL probes dangerous at (120.0,78.1) — chaser:wallflyer@64,80 (the wallflyer's contact: its `hitPlayer` gate fires against the player's start-of-tick box THIS tick (body at (111.0,88.0), forecast along the walk)). ⚠ The AVOID rung routes around RECTS and the probe asks the whole union, which includes the point tests a rect cannot carry (a disc hazard); that gap is why the ladder has a second rung.
  time: the aim is 71 px away and `mover.MOVER_RANGE` measures this search reaching 48 px as an UPPER BOUND at dwell 4. TIME is the contested LAST-MILE tool (kickoff §3.1); it is not a room-crossing one, and the bound is named rather than widened.
  bait: NO LIVE BODY's removal admits a corridor — the danger on this corridor is [enemy:wallflyer@128,80] and this room's live roster is [empty]. A bait moves a body along its own straight line; a static census body, a hazard volume and an arrow lane do not have one, and a body whose removal changes no corridor is not what is in the way.
  kill: the danger on this corridor is not a body this run can watch die — a kill needs a target whose removal the model OBSERVES (a live chaser or spinner the run steps; a live body without a recorded removal is not a target), and ⛔ a static "Enemy" body's own arrow death is REFUSED by name (§11.4): its clear is the tape's DECLARED v9 `at` row, and a second writer of one persistence slot is two cost models. (F4: the classes whose death the run computes, [SandTrap], are targets of the static arm, not of this one.)
  forced-hit: no forced hit is proven from (136.3,104.4): the hitless input [· · ·] survives 3 tick(s) — no hit is forced inside the bound (the witness, 1 fork(s), before the tree) (37 fork step(s))
